description:
Must have (in order importance): 
 · Angular2 
 · TypeScript 
 · JavaScript 
 · CSS/CSS3 and Flexbox 
 · RxJS (How to use Observables) 
 · HTML/HTML5 
 
 Good to have: 
 · JHipster 
 · D3.js 
 · webpack 
 · Strong Object Oriented Programming Knowledge 
 · Strong Self Learning Techniques 
 · Design Patterns 
 · Angular CLI 
 
 Should be able to create a basic CRUD Web App in Angular2 & TypeScript from scratch (the candidate can use webpack, SystemJS or Angular CLI for this) and have the ability to use JSON Mocks for it (using Observables if possible). 
 
 Handle routing and multiple components in order to achieve all this is a plus. 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
